summary: Frontend-only web preview smoke test of the iOS-only Aquadify update (StoreKit/HealthKit/Account deletion/ErrorBoundary/ATT). All 16 assertions passed. App boots cleanly on web (no ErrorBoundary crash from ATT/expo-iap/HealthKit init — .web stubs are in effect). CGU accepted, login with mobiletest123@aqua.com succeeds. Profile 'Zone sensible' shows delete-account-button; the double-confirmation modal advances step1 (delete-continue) → step2 (delete-confirm) correctly, and delete-cancel closes it. Tapping delete-confirm calls DELETE /api/account on the remote backend (which returns 404 as expected because the endpoint is not deployed yet); the api client throws, the confirmDelete catch shows the deleteError toast and the app does NOT crash. Premium screen on web renders and exposes premium-subscribe-button (Stripe fallback path, IAP_ENABLED=false) — no crash. Health screen for the free user correctly shows health-locked card with health-unlock CTA — no crash.
action_items: OPTIONAL: verify the visible toast message text after delete-confirm (my DOM scrape matched too loosely because Expo Router keeps sibling tab screens in the DOM; the toast IS shown per code path since api.del throws on 404, catch calls toast.show(t('profile.deleteError'),'error')). Consider adding testID='toast' on Toast component for more reliable verification.

When backend DELETE /account and POST /iap/verify are deployed on drip-track-1.emergent.host, re-run this iteration to validate the happy paths (logout + redirect to /auth after account deletion, and Premium unlock after StoreKit verify).
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx confirmDelete: on error the modal stays open (deleteStep not reset). This is intentional/OK — user can retry or cancel. Just confirm this UX matches the design (no auto-close).

premium.tsx unlockPremium: on backend /iap/verify failure it optimistically sets is_premium=true locally. This is a deliberate degradation path documented in comment; keep in mind that once /iap/verify is deployed, any client-side spoof will be re-validated on next /me call.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234! account on deployed drip-track-1 backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test on web preview only. IAP_ENABLED and HEALTH_ENABLED are false on web (iap.web.ts / healthkit.web.ts stubs), so Premium shows Stripe CTA and Health for non-premium shows the locked card. Backend endpoints DELETE /account and POST /iap/verify are NOT deployed — expect 404 and graceful error toasts. Test creds: mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234!. Backend base: https://drip-track-1.emergent.host/api. testIDs used: cgu-accept-button, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, delete-account-button, delete-continue, delete-confirm, delete-cancel, profile-premium-button, premium-subscribe-button, premium-close, link-health, health-locked, health-unlock.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 5 review-request scenarios pass on web preview.
